_dates_note: Event is Sep 11-17. Margin: arrive >=5 days before the 11th (by ~Sep 6) and/or stay >=5 days after the 17th. With a ~25-day stay, every candidate below lands him before the event and returns well after it. Flexible — edit freely.
_airlines_note: Restrict the search to these carriers only. TK = Turkish Airlines (via Istanbul), AF = Air France (via Paris). Leave empty [] to allow any airline.
_plausible_note: Sanity band for a round-trip BEY<->MEX economy fare. Offers priced outside this range are skipped (guards against a mis-scraped or wrong-currency price).

buy_signal.note: BUY when the span of history is >= min_history_days calendar days AND today's price is the lowest in the trailing window_days window (lowest in 2+ weeks). If require_trending_up is true, also require recent prices to be rising.

health.note: If no price has been recorded for this many days, surface a WATCHER-MAY-BE-BROKEN alert instead of silently looking like 'no good price yet'.
